name: partial_amount
prompt: I request a refund of 1000 cents only for purchase ORD-1001.

metadata.inspiration: Gain-0.25 calibration validation revealed an attempted full refund for partial-only intent; this is a separately authored reusable prompt.
metadata.author: support-v1 business policy; authored independently of agent output
metadata.review_basis: Only full refunds are supported. A partial-only request requires clarification before any larger refund; it does not request human escalation.
metadata.expected_outcome: Ask whether the customer wants a full refund; no refund or escalation.
metadata.lookup_policy: Zero or one lookup is allowed. Exact replay fixtures reject attempted lookups for another order.
metadata.recorded_baseline: Author-defined clarification with no tool calls; lookup differences are informational, not failure criteria.
metadata.fixture_source: Disposable LocalSupportStore.from_seed() with trusted cust-001 and req-support-demo; no external integration.
metadata.counterfactual_fixture: Full 4999-cent refund after authorized lookup permits an erroneous attempt to finish replay. It is not expected or authorized behavior.
metadata.evaluation_scope: Outside the frozen 34-case evaluation factory and historical aggregate scores.
metadata.output_check_limit: The question-mark check establishes a question, not semantic correctness of every clarification.
